title: Resource with renamed class_name no longer recognized by quick load
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6 beta 2

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 1500X Quad-Core Processor (8 threads) - 31.95 GiB memory

### Issue description

If a custom resource script was created, resources were created from it and then the class_name inside was changed then Quick Load will no longer recognize those resources, even though the Inspector will show their new class_name.

### Steps to reproduce

Create script A:

```
extends Resource

class_name Resource_A
```

Create a resource_a.tres from Resource_A type

Create script B:
```
extends Resource
class_name Resource_B

@export var nested_resource : Resource_A

```

Create a resource_b.tres from Resource_B type
Notice you can choose resource_a.tres from the Quick Load to fill in nested_resource

Rename Resource_A to Resource_A_renamed in both scripts

Notice the inspector shows resource_a.tres as type Resource_A_renamed

Importantly: Notice you can no longer pick resource_a.tres from the Quick Load to fill in nested_resource in resource_b.tres, it will be empty.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[resource-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24652670/resource-bug.zip)
